public.title: The Museum After Hours
public.blurb: Twenty-four people remain after closing. Follow their statements through fifteen museum rooms.
public.goal: Place everyone, then name the person who was alone with Elias.
rules: One person per row and column, including the victim.
Crossed squares are blocked. All other squares may be occupied, including furniture without a cross.
Beside means one square up, down, left or right, within the same area.
A corner touches two adjacent area boundaries. Doors do not merge areas.
Alone means no other person in the area. With means in the same area; alone with means exactly two people.
Outer border means the first or last row or column of the whole grid.
In front of a door/window means either of its two joined squares.
Offsets compare only the named coordinate. Area numbers start at 1; zero people is an even count.
Terrain is the ground layer, separate from named props that may share its label.
The murderer was alone with the victim: exactly two people in that area.
Specialist galleries are Antiquities Gallery, Music Gallery, Decorative Arts Gallery, Furniture Gallery, Natural History Gallery, Sculpture Gallery.
Rooms with a piano are Antiquities Gallery, Winter Garden, Covered Walk, Furniture Gallery, Reception.
Rooms with a table are Antiquities Gallery, Music Gallery, Decorative Arts Gallery, Grand Gallery, Reading Room, Collections Store.
Rooms with a tv are Grand Gallery, Furniture Gallery, Sculpture Gallery, Reception.
